lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into more complex vermiculated patterns dorsally and posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of higher luminance visible posterior to the gill slits, intersecting with circular blobs to form localized anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique labyrinthine or maze-like continuous line patterning on the mid-lateral flank above the pectoral fin insertion point.
